verdict.rationale: DBOS provides workflow orchestration, an MCP server for agents to inspect/manage workflows, and a Conductor dashboard for monitoring, but there is no evidence of the product itself generating AI-driven insights or suggestions about a user's data (e.g., anomaly detection, recommendations, or narrative summaries). The MCP integration (dbos-docs-14, dbos-probe-rt-3) lets external LLMs query workflow state, which is not the same as the product proactively surfacing AI-generated insights.
